description.mekanism.basic_chemical_tank: A tank that holds one chemical, filled and drained through the chemical capability.
description.mekanism.basic_crushing_fact: A factory that crushes three operations at once: one input and one output slot per process over one 30,000 FE buffer.
description.mekanism.basic_enriching_fac: A factory that enriches three operations at once: one input and one output slot per process over one 30,000 FE buffer.
description.mekanism.basic_injecting_fac: A factory that injects three operations at once: a 240,000 FE buffer and one shared 630-unit tank of the gas its recipes take.
description.mekanism.basic_purifying_fac: A factory that purifies three operations at once: a 120,000 FE buffer and one shared 630-unit oxygen tank.
description.mekanism.basic_smelting_fact: A factory that smelts three operations at once: one input and one output slot per process over one 30,000 FE buffer.
description.mekanism.chemical_injection_: An elite machine capable of processing ores into four shards, serving as the initial stage of 400% ore processing.
description.mekanism.crusher: A simple machine used to crush blocks and ores into their counterparts, such as cobblestone into gravel.
description.mekanism.energized_smelter: A simple machine that serves as a Mekanism-based furnace that runs off of energy.
description.mekanism.enrichment_chamber: A simple machine used to enrich ores into two of their dust counterparts, as well as perform many other operations.
description.mekanism.gauge_dropper: A hand-held container that carries up to 16,000 units of one chemical.
description.mekanism.purification_chambe: An advanced machine capable of processing ores into three clumps, serving as the initial stage of 300% ore processing.
